parameters.text:
=You are a YouTube content strategist AI. Generate 10 creative and trending video ideas for the following:

Niche/Topic: {{$json.niche}}
Target Audience: {{$json.targetAudience}}
Keywords: {{$json.keywords}}

For each idea, provide:
1. Video Title (catchy and SEO-optimized)
2. Brief Description (2-3 sentences)
3. Hook (first 10 seconds script)
4. Target Audience Pain Point
5. Trending Angle
6. Estimated Video Length
7. Content Difficulty (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced)
8. Viral Potential Score (1-10)

Format as JSON array with these fields.
Make ideas unique, engaging, and based on current trends.

=You are a professional YouTube scriptwriter. Write a complete, engaging video script for:

Video Title: {{$json.videoTitle}}
Topic: {{$json.videoTopic}}
Target Audience: {{$json.targetAudience}}
Video Length: {{$json.videoLength || '10-15 minutes'}}
Tone: {{$json.tone || 'Educational and Engaging'}}

Script Structure:
1. HOOK (First 10 seconds - grab attention immediately)
2. INTRODUCTION (30 seconds - introduce topic and what viewers will learn)
3. MAIN CONTENT (Divided into 3-5 key sections with timestamps)
   - Each section should have:
     * Clear heading
     * Talking points
     * Visual suggestions
     * B-roll ideas
4. ENGAGEMENT PROMPTS (Like, Subscribe, Comment reminders - naturally integrated)
5. CONCLUSION (Summary and call-to-action)
6. OUTRO (End screen suggestions)

Include:
- Timestamps for each section
- Visual cues and B-roll suggestions
- Text overlay suggestions
- Music/sound effect cues
- Editing notes

Make it conversational, engaging, and optimized for retention.

=You are a YouTube SEO expert. Optimize video metadata for maximum reach and engagement:

Video Title: {{$json.videoTitle}}
Video Topic: {{$json.videoTopic}}
Target Keywords: {{$json.keywords}}
Target Audience: {{$json.targetAudience}}

Generate:

1. OPTIMIZED TITLE (3 variations)
   - Include primary keyword
   - 60 characters or less
   - Clickable but not clickbait
   - Include numbers/power words when relevant

2. VIDEO DESCRIPTION (Full 5000 character optimization)
   - First 150 characters (what shows before "Show More")
   - Detailed description with timestamps
   - Relevant keywords naturally integrated
   - Links section (social media, resources)
   - Hashtags (3-5 relevant)
   - Call-to-action

3. TAGS (30 tags)
   - Mix of broad and specific
   - Include misspellings of main keywords
   - Related topics
   - Competitor channels

4. THUMBNAIL CONCEPTS (3 ideas)
   - Text overlay suggestions
   - Color scheme
   - Key visual elements
   - Emotion/expression to convey

5. BEST POSTING TIME
   - Based on niche and audience

6. PLAYLIST SUGGESTIONS
   - Which playlists to add this video to

Format as structured JSON.

parameters.text:
=You are a creative thumbnail designer and visual strategist. Generate detailed thumbnail concepts:

Video Title: {{$json.videoTitle}}
Niche: {{$json.niche}}
Target Audience: {{$json.targetAudience}}

Create 5 thumbnail concepts with:

1. MAIN VISUAL
   - Primary image/photo description
   - Suggested emotion/expression
   - Background style

2. TEXT OVERLAY
   - Exact text to use (3-5 words max)
   - Font style suggestions
   - Text placement
   - Text color and effects

3. COLOR SCHEME
   - Primary color
   - Secondary color
   - Accent color
   - Overall mood

4. DESIGN ELEMENTS
   - Icons/graphics to include
   - Arrows/emphasis elements
   - Border/frame style

5. PSYCHOLOGICAL TRIGGERS
   - What emotion does it evoke?
   - Why would someone click?
   - Curiosity gap created

6. DESIGN TOOLS
   - Canva template suggestion
   - Photoshop technique
   - Stock photo keywords

Each concept should be different in style and approach.
Format as JSON array.
